items.title: Evercore ISI Names Three Top Discount Retail Stocks for the Second Half
items.summary: Evercore ISI has selected three discount retailers as its preferred stocks within the global retail, apparel and luxury brands sector, pointing to opportunities for stronger performance during the second half of the year. The firm’s assessment focuses on companies where comparable sales trends, easier comparison periods or operational improvements could provide meaningful support despite an uncertain consumer and market backdrop.
